title: Lessons Without Borders? Evaluating Cultural Alignment of LLMs Using Multilingual Story Moral Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.08797v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Stories are key to transmitting values across cultures, but their interpretation varies across linguistic and cultural contexts. Thus, we introduce multilingual story moral generation as a novel culturally grounded evaluation task. Using a new dataset of human-written story morals collected across 14 language-culture pairs, we compare model outputs with human interpretations via semantic similarity, a human preference survey, and value categorization. We show that frontier models such as GPT-4o and Gemini generate story morals that are semantically similar to human responses and preferred by human evaluators. However, their outputs exhibit markedly less cross-linguistic variation and concentrate on a narrower set of widely shared values. translated_title: 无国界的教训？利用多语言故事道德生成评估大语言模型的文化对齐
translated_abstract: 故事是跨文化传播价值观的关键载体，但其解读会因语言和文化背景的不同而有所差异。因此，我们提出了多语言故事道德生成这一新颖的、以文化为根基的评估任务。基于一个涵盖14个语言-文化对、由人类撰写的故事道德解读新数据集，我们通过语义相似度、人类偏好调查和价值分类三种方式，将模型输出与人类解读进行比较。结果表明，GPT-4o和Gemini等前沿模型生成的故事道德在语义上与人类回答相似，且更受人类评估者的青睐。然而，这些模型的输出呈现出明显更小的跨语言差异，并集中于范围更窄的一组普遍共享的价值观。这些发现表明，尽管当代模型能够近似人类道德解读的中心趋势，但它们难以再现人类叙事所特有的多样性。
tldr: 该论文提出多语言故事道德生成作为评估大语言模型文化对齐的新任务，发现GPT-4o和Gemini等前沿模型虽能生成与人类相似且受偏好的故事道德，但其输出跨语言差异明显更小、价值观覆盖范围更窄，难以再现人类道德解读的多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces multilingual story moral generation as a novel culturally grounded evaluation task, showing that frontier models like GPT-4o and Gemini generate human-preferred, semantically similar morals but exhibit markedly less cross-linguistic variation and a narrower set of values, failing to reproduce the diversity of human moral interpretation.
